text: Qissa Nuuhu on ko jeyaaɗo e kumpite wirniiɗe. An Nulaaɗo, a anndaano ɗe an, yimɓe maa ɓen kadi anndaano ɗe ado oo wahayu mo Men wahayini e maaɗa. Muññor lorra yimɓe maa ɓen e ko ɓe fennata kon, wano Annabi Nuuhu muññornoo. Pellet ballal ngal e poolal ngal, wonanii ɗoftotooɓe yamirooje Alla ɗen ɓe woɗɗitoo haɗaaɗi Makko ɗin.
